title: Q-SEED-second-tenant: seed second-tenant is proposed, not yet built, deployed and running a year unattended
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** every watchdog run
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation seedship --probe second-tenant
**Status:** open

SEED-SHIP-1: a seed on the platform is built, deployed and made fully autonomous, designed to run unattended for at least one year. Seed `second-tenant` is at stage `proposed`. Still missing: instances/second-tenant/ship.json (what is built, where it is deployed, how it runs a year unattended). Build and deploy it on a branch through the normal lane; do not close this by editing the stage, a check or the baseline.
